note: physics (fields); no atlas group for it. Atlas has no electric-field node, so the edge uses vectors.

title.zh: 磁铁 · 铁屑显出看不见的线
title.en: Magnets · Iron Filings Reveal Unseen Lines

description.zh: 磁场在磁极附近最强，磁感线从 N 极出、进 S 极，异极相吸同极相斥。点磁极、平方反比的简化模型。
description.en: The field is strongest near the poles, field lines leave N and enter S, unlike poles attract and like poles repel. A simplified point-pole inverse-square model.

label.en: A field is a vector at every point

reason.zh: 指南针和铁屑小线段显示的是每个位置磁场的方向和大小，也就是给每个点配一个向量。
reason.en: The compasses and filings show the direction and size of the field at each position, that is, a vector assigned to every point.

title.zh: 看不见的磁场怎样被画出来？
title.en: How do we draw an invisible magnetic field?
